alias.description: A short name typed for the watch. With none, one is made from the two team names: the first three letters or digits of each in capitals, skipping the words both names start with when those would be the same (L84_Roach and L84_Smith show ROA and SMI), or HOM/AWY with no name (SET-5). Leave it out to have it follow the names.

colour.description: The team's primary color; the watch picks black or white text for contrast.

description: A team as typed in for one match. Saved teams come later, tied to a competition.
